system_prompt_style.note: cognitive_kernel.py not in evidence bundle; paper says backend converts state into a prompt but no mechanism shown.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the policy model will generate step-by-step plans, execute corresponding actions, and actively gather new state information as needed
env_context_strategy.note: Domain is web/files, not repos; memory retrieval also available as tool (CallMemoryKernel).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we condense the agent’s trajectory history by dynamically replacing previous observations with special tokens
context_compaction.note: Paper also mentions summarizing observations for files; code not in bundle.

observation_format.evidence_quote: use the web page’s accessibility tree as the observation to the agent due to its structural format and conciseness
observation_format.note: raw_text from code executor print output (code_executor.py custom_print).

tool_call_format.note: Line number approximate from bundle excerpt; paper Sec. 1 confirms Python as action medium.

tool_count.note: Functions AskLLM, CallMemoryKernel, CallWeb exposed as Python functions in code-as-action; count inferred from file tree.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool in function registry; paper says local files read-only. Code-as-action could write in container; not verifiable from bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file contents in bundle to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: This allows the system to generate a partial plan, execute it, and then decide the next moves based on the results and so on.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the policy model will generate step-by-step plans, execute corresponding actions
planning_granularity.note: Plans are text+code per step; no stored plan object evidenced.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the reasoning kernel — essentially an LLM-based policy model3 — generates the next action
multi_agent_topology.note: Perception tasks recursively invoke the same policy model (nested sub-tasks).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: it sends a request to the perception kernel with a specific instruction, which can be a more fine-grained level autopilot task
delegation_mechanism.note: Nested perception tasks via CallWeb; closest value.

human_in_loop.note: Feedback UI is for training, not gating; run loop not in bundle.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the backend docker will cache all intermediate execution results including the variables and function definitions in the memory

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: we parse the documents into different granularities and create semantics indexes (i.e., embeddings), accordingly

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The system continuously issues actions to explore the web until the stop action is generated or the trajectory reaches the maximum number of allowed steps.

timeouts.note: Only 600 s executor inactivity timer (code_executor.py), which stops idle executors; not a per-tool or run limit.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: the backend docker, which provides an isolated environment for planning execution
execution_isolation.note: Code exec'd in-process within backend container (code_executor.py exec).

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: we only allow the backend docker to read from the local file and cannot write into it
filesystem_access.note: Relative to host local file system; within container unclear.

network_policy.evidence_quote: we also equip Cognitive Kernel with the access to the open web

permission_model.note: Paper mentions internal safeguards without mechanism.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Cognitive Kernel is an open-sourced agent system designed to achieve the goal of building general-purpose autopilot systems.
target_domain.note: Also document QA and long-term memory.

open_source.evidence_quote: we release both the system and the backbone model

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we also consider a baseline where we switch the backbone model of Cognitive Kernel to GPT-4o
